title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Alloying and nanoscale architecture can alter oxygen-reduction activity in metallic aerogels, but composition–activity relationships need not be monotonic.
explanation: The review links Pt alloying to altered adsorption of oxygenated species and reports a volcano-shaped relationship between core lattice parameter and activity for PdAu–Pt core–shell aerogels.
conditions: The reported volcano relationship concerns the cited composition-tunable core–shell system.
caveats: Neither the proposed electronic explanation nor the particular optimum is a universal rule for all aerogels.
